name: com.smpro.skilltree
description: Data-driven skill, talent and upgrade trees. One tree asset holds every node, cost, requirement and effect; stats are computed from node levels; effects, conditions, cost curves, currencies and save providers are pluggable. Includes a generated uGUI tree view (needs PrimeTween), a graph editor, a balance table, validation and a play-mode debugger.

samples.description: A 7-node RPG tree in its own scene: stats panel, a SimpleWallet with gold buttons, a mystery keystone, conditions, and a feature that uses temporary stat modifiers.
